productArea.name: Orders
productArea.scope: Search, filter, and sort orders and drafts, then manage draft line items, customer and shipping assignment, payments, fulfillment, returns, replacements, refunds, and order processing settings. Customer records, shipping configuration, and channel policies are outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Fulfillment then Orders, and open an order for its payment, fulfillment, return, and refund pages.
Choose Fulfillment then Drafts to create or edit a draft and complete it as an order.
Choose Orders and fulfillment from Configuration to edit order processing, fulfillment, and refund settings.
